changeSet.author: techchallenge
changeSet.comment: Cria a tabela principal de feedbacks com constraint de nota e default de data
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE feedbacks ( id INT IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY, descricao NVARCHAR(MAX) NOT NULL, nota INT NOT NULL CHECK (nota BETWEEN 0 AND 10), urgencia VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL, criado_em DATETIME2 NOT NULL DEFAULT GETDATE() )
